title: itembank tier-gate candidate contract
description: The closed candidate envelope the tier gate accepts from a provider: exactly one of hint_plan or rubric_proposal, no unknown fields, no learner-facing free-prose channel. The gate itself enforces the bounded-policy edges the in-repo validator cannot express (maxItems 2 fact_ids, maxLength 240 rationale) after schema validation; see tier_gate.evaluate_candidate.

kind.description: Discriminates the candidate envelope; a candidate that does not name one is rejected.

interaction_id.description: The immutable interaction id the runtime minted; at most one generation per id (D-12).

focus_span.description: A normalized-whitespace exact substring of the learner's most recent genuine wrong response; zero or more-than-one matches drop (D-10).

fact_ids.description: References into the runtime-built fact manifest; at most 2 distinct entries (gate-enforced), each allowed and non-ambiguous, never a provider label.

move.description: The one tutoring move the runtime renderer is allowed to emit; templates never assert correctness of any option.

kind.description: Discriminates the candidate envelope; a candidate that does not name one is rejected.

interaction_id.description: The immutable interaction id the runtime minted.

point_index.description: Index into the item's authored rubric point list.

status.description: A per-point suggestion only; it never mutates the response score or creates an accepted mark (D-14).

rationale.description: Bounded provider rationale for this point; maxLength 240 is gate-enforced because the in-repo validator does not implement maxLength. Scanned for protected-fragment overlap.

points.description: Empty is valid and renders as pending/unknown, never a default pass.
